pre_frozen_resolution_contract.coarse: chromatic anthocyanin pigmentation present versus absent, or source-equivalent binary biochemical presence state
pre_frozen_resolution_contract.intermediate: source-defined major anthocyanin/anthocyanidin biochemical class using a semantics-only mapping frozen before values are inspected
pre_frozen_resolution_contract.fine: source-defined visible hue/reflectance class; if continuous-only, external colour-space cutpoints must be frozen before target values are inspected

published_aggregate_counterexamples: orange/red source colour groups contain DEO90, DEO+HYD and HYD90 samples
non-orange/red source colour groups contain HYD90, NONE and smaller DEO90/DEO+HYD fractions
nesting_audit.reason: source-defined visible/reflectance groups do not map one-to-one or many-to-one into the source-defined pigment-chemistry classes; the two axes cross-cut

stop_rule_triggered: HOLD_SCHEMA if three nested levels cannot be instantiated without outcome-dependent recoding
forbidden_rescue: derive new reflectance cutpoints after inspecting source rows
collapse pigment classes using realized frequencies
choose a hue-to-pigment mapping that maximizes phylogenetic AUC
replace the frozen fine visible/reflectance axis with an exact-anthocyanidin-composition axis
reopen_rule: reopen only with a source-defined or independently pre-frozen three-level nesting on one underlying trait axis before row-level target outcomes are inspected
